div.head: II As 15
div.ab: Be scyldwyrhtum. We cwædon, þæt nán scyldwyrhta ne lecge nán sceapes felle on scyld; ⁊ gif he hit dó, gylde XXX scill.
Feorðe: þæt nan scyldwyrhta ne lecge nan scepes fel on scyld; ⁊ gif he hit dó, gilde XXX scll'.
[Be scyld …] Feorðe: þæt nan … ecgge nan scepes fell on sceld; ⁊ gif he hit …
De scuta facientibus. Et nullus scyldpyrhta (id est scutum faciens) ponat pellem ouis in scuto. Si quis hoc faciat, emendet XXX sol.
[Be scyldwyrhtum.] [Ld] Feorðe: þæt nan scyldwyrhta ne lecge nan scepes fel on scyld; ⁊ gif he dó, gilde XXX scll'.
Fourthly [we declare] that no shield-maker shall cover a shield with sheepskin. If he does he shall pay 30 shillings.
(Von Schildmachern. So Ld) Viertens (Wir bestimmten Ld): dass kein Schildmacher ein Schafsfell auf den Schild lege; und wenn er es thut, zahle er 30 Schill. [dem König].
(Of shield-makers. So Ld) Fourthly (We determined, Ld): that no shield-maker put a sheepskin on a shield; and if he does it, let him pay 30 shillings [to the king].
